notes: The registry is generated, not hand-written: make -C oracle blocks-h regenerates blocks.h from the live oracle objects, so every static property is exact by construction. The mutable block-bounds fields have no single native home; every consumer keeps its own copy, which the GPU contract requires (no shared mutable state). Every symbol cited above was verified present in the named file. The canBlockGrass and tick-rate defaults are the two places the generated table flattens rather than names a flag. lane/idxblocks (2026-09-27): every member is exact or a documented switch (maps, redstone, anvil for names). The localized-name, creative-tab and sub-block members are client text and stay n/a. idx-blocks-s1 (note click, snow and vine harvests, trapdoor, tripwire shears, silverfish egg) and idx-randomtick-s1 (snow melt, vine spread, lava fire) pin the block callbacks this lane checked.
